architecture_source: BitLogic Table 6 common protocol, rank-2 DiffLogic coordinate

data.augmentation: random horizontal flip and random crop with reflect-mode padding
data.heldout_test_policy: locked until each scale's winner and comparators are frozen

training.note: No early stopping, label smoothing, gradient clipping, mixed precision, or LR schedule.

S.partial_first_layer_coverage: opt-in uniform maximal subset for both paired methods

promotion.S_to_M: positive mean paired CoverageDLGN gain after three-seed 20K selection
promotion.M_to_L: positive mean paired CoverageDLGN gain after three-seed 20K selection
promotion.comparators: Mommen three seeds on S; one seed first on M/L, promote only if competitive; LILogic local on S only; remaining values reported-only
